titleBn: ঢাকায় ফিরছে ভিনাইল আর ক্যাসেটের দিন
summaryBn: ভুলে যাওয়া স্মৃতিকে নতুন করে উপভোগ করছে ঢাকা। ভিনাইল ও ক্যাসেটের এই পুনর্জাগরণে যাঁরা ভূমিকা রাখছেন, তাঁদের কয়েকজনকে ধন্যবাদ জানিয়েছে বি-পপ ট্যাগস।
lede: Dhaka is rediscovering a forgotten memory, one record and tape at a time. Here's who B-POP Tags thanked for it.
body:
"Dhaka is enjoying rejuvenation of the forgotten memory." With that line, B-POP Tags marked a shift many collectors will recognise: the return of vinyl and cassettes in Dhaka, and the people helping it happen.

## Who's bringing back vinyl and cassettes in Dhaka

The post thanks four accounts by name, [@vinylmadnessbd](https://www.instagram.com/vinylmadnessbd/), [@saadimhuq](https://www.instagram.com/saadimhuq/), [@sursaptakvinyls](https://www.instagram.com/sursaptakvinyls/) and [@cassettebangla](https://www.instagram.com/cassettebangla/), "and many more". Then it asks the question: "NOW ARE YOU READY?" It's an invitation as much as a thank-you, aimed at anyone who hasn't yet held a record or a tape.

## Analog on the cover

The graphic is a love letter to physical formats. A tall stack of Maxell cassettes carries hand-drawn, anime-style artwork across the cases, a figure in sunglasses wears headphones around his neck, and below them colourful discs drift across a bright blue sky.

## Go deeper

Looking for where to start digging? Our guides to physical media shops in Dhaka, [part 1](post:physical-media-shops-dhaka-part-1) and [part 2](post:physical-media-shops-dhaka-part-2), are the natural next stop. And if your love of physical media extends to print, read about [Jamil's Comics and Bangladesh's comic book culture](post:jamils-comics-bangladesh-comic-book-culture).

More analog stories live in [Pop Culture & Analog](topic:pop-culture) and on the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).
